```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Disable scientific notation
options(scipen=999)

Neuroethics_Judgement %>% 
 dplyr::select(user_id, condition, Risk_Beta, Gain_Beta, marginal.effect.risk, marginal.effect.gain, marginal.effect.P.risk , marginal.effect.P.gain, Yes, No, age, sex, Income, education, task_completed) %>% 
  mutate(marginal.effect.P.risk = ifelse(marginal.effect.P.risk < 0.05, "significant", "not_significant" )) %>% 
  mutate(marginal.effect.P.gain = ifelse(marginal.effect.P.gain < 0.05, "significant", "not_significant" )) %>% 
  filter(! sex == "Other") %>%# only have 3 people who reported other as sex
  filter(! Income == 0) %>%  #we have two subject who reported no income as zero
  filter(! user_id == "RU3gTWzp") %>% #we only have a single subject less than high school 
  mutate(logIncome = log(Income)) %>% 
  #we only have a single subject with less than a high school degee
  mutate(education_recode = fct_recode(education,
  HighSchool = "high school degree",
  Undergraduate = "bachelor",
  Postgraduate = "masters",
  Postgraduate = "Doctoral/Professional")) %>% 
  distinct() -> data.h
data.h$education_recode <- factor(data.h$education_recode)
data.h$sex <- factor(data.h$sex)
```

##Risk, benefit marginal effects for each cog domain

```{r echo=FALSE, dpi= 300}
ggplot(data.h,aes(x = marginal.effect.risk , y = marginal.effect.gain)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = condition), size = 1.5, alpha = .7) 

data.h %>% 
  dplyr::select(user_id, condition, marginal.effect.risk, marginal.effect.gain) %>% 
  reshape2::melt(id = c("user_id", "condition") , variable.name = "type", value.name = "marginal.effect") -> test

plotdata <- test %>%
  group_by(type, condition) %>%
  summarize(n = n(),
            mean = mean(marginal.effect),
            sd = sd(marginal.effect),
            se = sd/sqrt(n),
            ci = qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sd / sqrt(n)) %>% na.omit()

pd <- position_dodge(0.6)
ggplot(plotdata, aes(x =type, 
                     y= mean,
                     ymin = mean - 2*se,
                     ymax= mean + 2*se, 
                     group=condition,
                     color=condition)) +
  scale_x_discrete('Type')+
  scale_y_continuous('Marginal Effect',limits=c(-0.005,.01)) +
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = type, y = mean),size=1,width=.2, position = pd) + 
  geom_point(position=pd, size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0) + 
  labs(x = "Type", 
       y = "Average Marginal Effect", 
       title  = "AVE for Model by Cognive Domain")

knitr::kable(plotdata[1:7,], caption = "Descriptives for Risk by Cog domain")%>%  
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")
knitr::kable(plotdata[8:14,], caption = "Descriptives for Gain by Cog domain")%>%  
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")


data.h %>% 
  dplyr::select(user_id, marginal.effect.risk, marginal.effect.gain) %>% 
  mutate(marginal.effect.risk = -marginal.effect.risk) %>% 
  reshape2::melt(id = c("user_id") , variable.name = "type", value.name = "marginal.effect") -> test

data.h %>% 
  dplyr::select(user_id, condition, marginal.effect.risk, marginal.effect.gain) %>% 
    mutate(marginal.effect.risk = -marginal.effect.risk) %>% 
  reshape2::melt(id = c("user_id", "condition") , variable.name = "type", value.name = "marginal.effect") -> test

plotdata <- test %>%
  group_by(type, condition) %>%
  summarize(n = n(),
            mean = mean(marginal.effect),
            sd = sd(marginal.effect),
            se = sd/sqrt(n),
            ci = qt(0.975,df=n-1)*sd/sqrt(n),
            lower = mean - ci,
            upper = mean + ci
            ) %>% na.omit() 

 ggplot(data=plotdata,
    aes(type, mean, ymin = lower, ymax = upper ))+
    geom_pointrange(aes(col=type))+
    geom_hline(aes(fill=type),yintercept =0, linetype=2)+
    xlab('type')+ ylab("Marginal Effect (95% Confidence Interval)")+
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lower, ymax = upper,col=type),width=0.5,cex=1)+ 
    facet_wrap(~condition,strip.position="left",nrow=7,scales = "free_y") +
    theme(plot.title=element_text(size=16,face="bold"),
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_text(face="bold"),
        axis.title=element_text(size=12,face="bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(hjust=0,vjust = 1,angle=180,face=  "bold"))+
    coord_flip() + 
    theme(legend.position="none")
```

##Statistical test for gain vs. benefit 
```{r Statistical test for loss vs. gain}
data.h %>% 
  dplyr::select(user_id, condition, marginal.effect.risk, marginal.effect.gain, Yes, No) %>% 
  mutate(marginal.effect.risk = -marginal.effect.risk) %>% 
  reshape2::melt(id = c("user_id", "condition", "Yes", "No") , variable.name = "type", value.name = "marginal.effect") -> test
test$condition <- relevel(test$condition, "Mood")

lm.1 <- lm(marginal.effect ~ type, test) 

lm.2 <- lm(marginal.effect ~ type + No, test) 

lm.3 <- lm(marginal.effect ~ type*No, test)

anova(lm.1, lm.2, lm.3, test="LRT")

summary(lm.1)
```

**Table 1:** Main effects and interaction linear models for Average Marginal effects controling for responsce count.
```{r printLM table,echo=FALSE}
tab_model(lm.1, lm.2, lm.3, 
          digits = 4, 
          show.df = T, 
          show.stat = T, 
          string.pred = "Ind. Variable", 
          col.order = c("est","ci","df","stat","p"), 
          dv.labels = c("Type", "Type + No", "Type*No")
          )
```
*Note:* The Statistic represent the t-statistic used to obtain the p-value. CI = the 95% confidence interval of the Estimate. 

```{r echo=FALSE}
t <- t.test(marginal.effect ~ type,  paired = TRUE, alternative = "two.sided", conf.level = 0.95,var.equal = T, data =test)
tab <- map_df(list(t), tidy)
knitr::kable(tab[c("estimate", "statistic", "p.value", "parameter", "conf.low", 
"conf.high", "method")])%>%  
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")
```

##Do people overweigh small probabilities & underweight large probabilities?
```{r}
###### MER for each subject
m.marginal <- by(Neuroethics_Judgement, Neuroethics_Judgement$user_id, function(x) margins::margins(glm(experimental_treatment_selected ~ risk  + gain, data = x, family = binomial(link = "logit"))))

#run logit model
user_id <- names(m.marginal)

marginal.effect <- list()

n = 448

for (i in 1:n){
dat = m.marginal[[i]]
  marginal.effect[[i]] = dat
}
subjectModels.marginal <- do.call(rbind, marginal.effect)


subjectModels.marginal %>% 
  dplyr::select(user_id, risk,gain,dydx_risk, dydx_gain) %>% 
    mutate(dydx_risk = dydx_risk)%>% 
    reshape2::melt(id = c("user_id","risk", "gain"), 
         variable.name = "dydx", value.name = "MER") %>% 
 reshape2::melt(id = c("user_id", "dydx", "MER"), variable.name = "type", value.name = "index") %>% 
  mutate(MER = MER*5) -> test #resturcture the data


plot <- test %>%
  group_by(index,dydx,type) %>%
  summarize(n = n(),
            mean = mean(MER),
            median = median(MER),
            sd = sd(MER),
            se = sd/sqrt(n)) %>% na.omit

plot
pd <- position_dodge(0.3)

ggplot(plot, 
       aes(x = index, 
           y = mean, 
           group=dydx,
           color=dydx)) +
  geom_point(position=pd, 
             size = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, 
                    ymax = mean + se), 
                width = .1, 
                position = pd, 
                size = 1) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette="Set1") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Average Marginal Effect of a Representative Risk & Benefit Index",
       subtitle =  paste("(mean +/- standard error) Subject:",toString(i)),
       x = "", 
       y = "",
       color = "Attribute")+
  scale_x_continuous("Probablitiy", breaks=seq(5,90,5), limits=c(5, 90))+
  scale_y_continuous("MarginalEffect", breaks=seq(,90,5), limits=c(5, 90))+

  facet_wrap(~type, nrow = 2)
```

```{r education, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(tab[c("term", "estimate", "std.error", "statistic", "p.value")], caption = "Predicting AME given R/B and education")%>%  
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")
```

##Income
```{r income,  echo=FALSE}
data.h %>% 
  dplyr::select(marginal.effect.risk, marginal.effect.gain, Income, Yes, No) -> data.income
data.income$Incomecat<-cut(data.h$Income, c(0, 25000,50000,75000, 200000))
data.income %>% 
  mutate(income_recode = fct_recode(Incomecat,
  "< 25,000" = "(0,2.5e+04]",
  "25,000-50,000" = "(2.5e+04,5e+04]",
  "50,000-75,000"= "(5e+04,7.5e+04]",
  "> 75,000" = "(7.5e+04,2e+05]")) %>% 
  filter(!Income == 0) %>% 
  mutate(Income = log(Income))-> data.income
 
#risk 
lm.income.risk <- lm(marginal.effect.risk ~ Income, data.income)

tab <- map_df(list(lm.income.risk), tidy)
knitr::kable(tab[c("term", "estimate", "std.error", "statistic", "p.value")], caption = "Predicting Risk given Continuous Income")%>%  
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")

lm.income.risk <- lm(marginal.effect.risk ~ income_recode, data.income)

tab <- map_df(list(lm.income.risk), tidy)
knitr::kable(tab[c("term", "estimate", "std.error", "statistic", "p.value")], caption = "Predicting Risk given Categorical Income")%>%  
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")

ggplot(data.income, aes(x=log(Income), y=marginal.effect.risk)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, color = "red") +
    geom_point()

income <- data.income %>% 
  group_by(income_recode) %>%
  summarize(n = n(),
         mean = mean(marginal.effect.risk),
         sd = sd(marginal.effect.risk),
         se = sd / sqrt(n),
         ci = qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sd / sqrt(n)) %>% na.omit()
knitr::kable(income, caption = "Descriptives for risk by income")%>%  
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")
# plot the means and standard errors
ggplot(income, 
       aes(x = income_recode, 
           y = mean, 
           group = 1)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, 
                    ymax = mean + se), 
                width = .1) + 
   labs(x = "Income", 
       y = "Mean", 
       title  = "Risk by Income")

tab <- map_df(list(lm.income.gain), tidy)
```
